# NRG Bloom

> Converting stranded energy into AI-ready compute infrastructure.

NRG Bloom deploys modular data centers on stranded and flared gas sites in emerging markets. Stage-gated approach: validate the site with Bitcoin mining, harden the build, then scale to AI inference. Operational in Bayelsa State, Nigeria since February 2025.

## What We Do
- Deploy containerized compute infrastructure on stranded energy sources
- Validate sites with Bitcoin mining (60-90 day deployment, immediate revenue, zero SLA risk)
- Scale proven sites to AI/GPU inference workloads
- Mitigate gas flaring while generating revenue for energy partners

## Key Metrics
As of August 2026. Figures below are operating results unless labelled target or pipeline.
- 1 MW energized (1.5 MW developed) at Ogboinbiri, Bayelsa State, Nigeria
- Operational since February 2025
- 5 MW pipeline under development
- $0.03/kWh energy cost under a community-based power purchase agreement
- 300+ tonnes CO₂e mitigated
- 94% operational uptime
- <1.2 PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness): target, not a result
- 5 local jobs created at Ogboinbiri

## Partnership Criteria
We partner with energy producers who have:
- 5 MW+ of stranded or flared gas availability
- Remote or off-grid sites with road access
- Regulatory pressure to reduce flaring or venting
- Interest in ESG-aligned, shared-revenue models
